descriptions.zh: [toxic_field_country.GetAdj]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。通过研究毒性的效果，我们可以开发出一个疗法缓解这个情况，同时还能规避我们的特工在视觉上暴露给目标[toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural]的风险。
descriptions.en: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] habitat is mildly toxic to our own operatives. By studying its effects, we can develop a remedy and so avoid the risks associated with having visibly-allergic [toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside their hive.

descriptions.zh: [excess_noise_country.GetName]为自己创造的环境产生了比我们预计还要多的静电噪声。我们的伪装无人机时不时经历数据丢失。通过研究这些非正常频域的频率，我们可以对我们的特工无人机进行重新调制，使得其能够维持高功能性并避免在力场中被检测到。
descriptions.en: The environment which the [excess_noise_country.GetName] creates for itself generates more electrostatic noise than we had anticipated. Our disguised drones are experiencing patchy data loss as a result. By studying these errant frequencies, we can re-tune our operative drones to maintain higher function and avoid detection 'in the field'.

descriptions.zh: 我们的研究人员承诺将利用近来与[contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的遭遇经历，将作为一个万能的、可即刻将任何给定的语言翻译成我们自己的语言的翻译系统的起点。即使他们最终未能成功，我们也希望他们能够对我们的通讯系统进行显著改进。
descriptions.en: Our researchers promise that our recent encounter with the [contacted_hummers.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has given them the beginnings of a translation system able to translate any given language into our own instantly. Even if they fall short of this, it is our hope that they will be able to upgrade our communication systems considerably.

descriptions.zh: 在与[encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的接触过程中，我们发现他们用来沟通的发光模式和进出超空间航道的漩涡之间有着惊人的相似之处。对这个问题的进一步研究可能会使我们对星系的基本组成部分有所了解。
descriptions.en: During our encounter with the [encountered_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we discovered some astounding similarities between the patterns of light they use to communicate and the swirls of interstellar space that make hyperlane travel possible. Investigating further into this topic may shed some light on the fundamental building blocks of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，但是他们——不，是我们——某种观念已经开始渗入了我们的内心，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]一族命中注定应该完成某个更加伟大的事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的“群体性癔症”——耳边响起承诺将统治星河的低声细语的癔症。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, but they - we - have become preoccupied with the notion that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们与§H虚境§!的遭遇让我们……发生了变化。泽珞的神秘残余永远与我们的壳绑定在一起。我们已经成为灯塔，召唤着另彼岸的存在。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Our encounters with the §HShroud§! have left us... changed. The uncanny residue of Zro is forever bound to our shells. We have become beacons, calling out to those on the other side.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的集体内部感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种用统一的思想囊括整个星系的追求。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。我们应该集中全部的精力，找寻这一冲动的起源。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
We have sensed alien impulses within our collective - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind encompassing the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. We shall give our undivided attention to finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic1Desc]
descriptions.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic1Desc]

descriptions.zh:
现存的理论是——我们所处的宇宙和虚境是相互连接的——一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。我们应该好好测试一下这个理论。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
The current theory is that the universe we know and the Shroud are linked - and that particularly disruptive events may have a 'ripple effect' translating from one dimension to the other. This theory should be put to the test.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
科学辅助程序已经给出了一个假设，即在我们所熟知的宇宙和代号：“虚境”的维度间存在某种可感知的连接。我们建议就该猜想进行进一步的实验与映射。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have produced a hypothesis that there are tangible links between the known universe and dimension ID: 'the Shroud'. Further experimentation and mapping of these supposed connections is advised.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们假定所有智慧物种都有能力与§H虚境§!产生联结。如果能够得到明确的证实，我们就能开始计算目前困境的解决方法。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
We hypothesize that all sapient beings have the capacity for connections with the §HShroud§!. If this can be conclusively proven, we can begin to calculate an approach to our current predicament.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们最杰出的[root.GetResearcherPlural]现已确认了当前宇宙与虚境连接的存在。我们必须找到更多与这个现实层面沟通的方法。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Our finest [root.GetResearcherPlural] have confirmed a connection between this realm and the Shroud. We must find more ways to interact with this new layer of reality.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic2Desc]
descriptions.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic2Desc]

descriptions.zh:
我国实力与日俱增——加之无可否认的使命感将我们整个物种团结在了一起——让我们的科学家确信，我们已经接受来自虚境的注能。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
The strengthening of our dominion - combined with the undeniable sense of purpose that is unifying our species - has led our scientists to believe that we are already being fueled by the energies of the Shroud.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
边缘假想已经建档。一旦确认，其潜在的利益将会远远超出预测范围。假想概括：[Root.GetName]已经在从代号：“虚境”的空间汲取§Y<<未识别资源>>§!。建议进一步调查。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Fringe hypothesis indexed. If confirmed, potential benefit far exceeds initially predicted range. Summary: [Root.GetName] may already be siphoning §Y<<resource undefined>>§! from ID: 'the Shroud'. Further investigation is advised.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学子例程正准备结束关于智慧意识和§H虚境§!之间关联的研究。我们观测到了代号：“情感”和虚境之间的强相关性。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
Our scientific subroutines are preparing to conclude research on the connection between sapient cognition and the §HShroud§!. We have observed a correlation between ID: 'emotions' and stronger links to the Shroud.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
随着我们夺取的星球愈多，[root.GetGestaltEntityName]愈发拓展，我们也能感受到那股冲动愈发强烈。现在这股冲动已经不再是朦胧的感觉，而是一股引导我们迎接即将到来的伟大的洪流——我们的意志将上升。

§H研究这类特殊项目将推动我们通往§P星海天罚§!之路的进展。§!
descriptions.en:
As we take more worlds, expanding the [root.GetGestaltEntityName], we can feel the impulses growing stronger. No longer mere feelings, they have become a guiding sense of greatness yet to come - of our mind ascended.

§HResearching Special Projects like this one will progress us further along the path of §PGalactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]
descriptions.en: [GetCrisisProjectPsionic3Desc]

descriptions.zh:
是时候寻找一个方法将虚境的能量释放到现世，并驯服这股常人无法理解的能量源泉了。

根据现有的理论，一股足够大的能量激增或许可以撕裂两个位面之间的屏障，最终让两个宇宙合二为一。

虚境天威恢恢然，能者夺之。让我们来夺走吧。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!
descriptions.en:
The time has come to find a way to unleash the energies of the Shroud, and tap into this unfathomable source of power.

The current theory is that a sufficiently large power surge could rupture the barrier between dimensions, ultimately leading to the two realities merging.

The energies of the Shroud belong to those who seize it. So let us seize it.

§HResearching this Special Project will further establish us as §Pa Galactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
科学理论子例程完成了一项新的有关代号“虚境”的假说，其内容包括如何全面地获取虚境释放的能量。

请求：积累更多数据。
建议行动：将最优能量和行动容量转移至科学分支，并进一步进行扰乱型互动（指令：“天灾”），以在另一位面（代号“虚境”）造成更大的波动。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!
descriptions.en:
Scientific theory subroutines have synthesized a new hypothesis involving ID: 'the Shroud' and how to finally benefit from its energy output.

Request: Accumulate more data.
Recommended action: Divert energy and operational capacity to scientific divisions and perform further disruptive actions (designation: 'Crisis') for the sake of causing measurable fluctuations in the alternate dimension (ID: 'the Shroud').

§HResearching this Special Project will further establish us as §Pa Galactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
我们又获得了关于有机智能和§H虚境§!之间联系的新洞见。将认知压力源施加在有机智能身上将会使其显著地释放灵能能量。工程学子例程现在将会尝试操纵这份能量以备将来使用。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!
descriptions.en:
New insight has been gained on the relationship between organic sapients and the §HShroud§!. Applying cognitive stressors to organic sapients has led to significant output of psionic energy. Engineering subroutines will now attempt to harness this energy for further use.

§HResearching this Special Project will further establish us as §Pa Galactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
如果我们要彻底地激发我们的潜势，这条通路就必须打开。这种原始的，双态的现实必须终结。我们必须找到某种办法将两个宇宙合二为一。而在新的现实位面，我们的意志将成为独一无二。

§H研究这个特殊项目将树立我们作为§P星海天罚§!的身份。§!
descriptions.en:
The path must be opened if we are to realize our full potential. This crude, dual state of reality must end. We must find a way to turn two universes into one. It will be our will alone that fills this new reality.

§HResearching this Special Project will further establish us as §Pa Galactic Nemesis§!.§!

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的这座工厂已荒废颓败了数个世纪，仿佛随时都要垮塌得支离破碎。它在行星的殖民地建立之初曾扮演过重要的作用，我们的殖民家出面并要求我们进入这座工厂，并使其修复如新，恢复往日荣光。

回报：£alloys£§G合金§!
descriptions.en:
The factory on [Root.GetName] has been decaying for centuries already, and is reaching a point where it might fall apart at any moment. As it has played an instrumental role in the foundation of the colony on the planet, our colonists have reached out and asked us to step in and make sure the building will be restored to former glory.

Reward: £alloys£ §GAlloys§!

descriptions.zh: 在这座星球上生活的机器人最近消失了，其他的许多殖民者也是如此。我们的工程师正在试图搜寻它们最近的信号以溯源，来看看我们能不能找到这些殖民者和机器人。
descriptions.en: The robot inhabiting the planet has recently disappeared - as has a large number of our colonists. Our engineers are looking into tracking its remote signals back to the source, to see if we can find the colonists and the robot.

descriptions.zh: 能源电网的全球性故障使我们的首都陷入了完全的黑暗。我们必须恢复§H[root.GetName]§!的电力基础设施，并压实相应责任主体。
descriptions.en: A global failure of the energy grid has plunged our capital into total darkness. We must restore §H[root.GetName]§!'s power infrastructure and determine what is taking place.

descriptions.zh:
又一次，万华镜寄生虫锁死了我们的电网，消耗我们的能源供给，使行星陷入黑暗。

幸运的是，我们现在知道如何应对。
descriptions.en:
Once again, the Kaleidoscope has latched to our power grid, consuming our energy and plunging the planet into darkness.

Fortunately, we now know how to respond.
